notes: The complete near-site Keban dam exterior, with its north rock-fill wedge, DSİ slope lettering, six crest gates, three concrete spillway lanes, eight mapped penstocks, twin lower outlet portals, and shore powerhouse and switchyard. The main footprint and orientation follow retained exact way 28431893, while the penstocks, powerhouse, and downstream portal mouths use native PMTiles controls. Gate heights, pipe diameters, chute grade, portal crowns, and electrical equipment are visually interpreted. The modeled water levels are approximate; the gates show a static operating state.
